messages:
maya.prod: quick follow-up from the all-hands 1: two asks: clarify how the API variant rollout works and what customers need to change.
leo.pm: good Q. variants are a routing layer label, not new model IDs. apps don't have to change, but we'll add opt-in flags and a response header so teams can verify.
chun.eng: dev note: header will be `x-rw-variant` and logs will include `model_variant` to help billing/tracing. example: `x-rw-variant: latency-optimized-v1`.
maya.prod: will Dedicated/private behave the same? worried about capacity and billing differences.
leo.pm: behavior is consistent across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Dedicated may route to different pools; billing attribution for cached tokens is different for Dedicated customers (will be in release notes).
anya.cto: important: no output changes expected from Optimize suggestions. those are config proposals only (batching, kv-cache, quant profiles). they will show estimated cost impact and a confidence score.
maya.prod: beta signup + docs timeline?
leo.pm: beta signups open in ~3 weeks via Console > Early Access. docs + migration checklist posted to #eng-releases and customer portal concurrently. hosted plans get 90d backfill; Dedicated/Private backfill begins once agent v2.1 is installed.
chun.eng: canary plan: default flow 5% for 6h -> 20% for 24h -> full. auto-rollback triggers: >1% absolute errors OR p95 latency >25% vs baseline OR error-rate x3 baseline. alarms notify eng-oncall + release channel. thresholds are adjustable per deployment.
maya.prod: ok, i'll coordinate a cross-functional readout and collect any teams needing longer betas.
release-bot: canary dry-run scheduled 2026-08-04T03:00:00Z to cluster-us-central-1.
leo.pm: thanks everyone 1: will share the header spec and a couple curl + curl-with-flag examples when the beta doc is up.
